papers.title: BanglaBERT-OCR: Transformer-based Document Text Extraction from Degraded Scanned Bengali Archives
papers.summary: This undergraduate thesis proposes a custom vision-language transformer architecture specifically fine-tuned for extracting degraded, low-resolution Bengali historical and administrative manuscripts. Achieves 94.2% character accuracy on complex conjunctive characters (Juktakkhor).

papers.title: Lightweight Edge-AI Model for Real-Time Traffic Congestion Prediction in Dhaka Megacity
papers.summary: Published in IEEE International Conference on Smart Systems 2025. Proposes a quantized neural network model running on Raspberry Pi and NVIDIA Jetson edge nodes to predict bottleneck congestions 15 minutes in advance using CCTV feeds.

papers.title: Zero-Knowledge Authentication Protocol for Decentralized Student Academic Credential Verification
papers.summary: Master's thesis presenting a privacy-preserving zk-SNARK protocol that allows university students to prove GPA thresholds and graduation credentials to employers without revealing complete transcript history or sensitive PII.

papers.title: Deep Attention ResNet for Automated Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy from Retinal Fundus Scans
papers.summary: Published in Journal of Medical Systems & Informatics. Implements dual-attention residual networks for multi-grade classification of diabetic retinopathy, evaluated across 12,000 anonymized hospital fundus images with 97.8% AUC.

papers.title: Microservice Fault Injection & Self-Healing Resilience in High-Load Kubernetes Clusters
papers.summary: Undergraduate thesis examining automated chaos engineering tests and predictive container auto-scaling under synthetic DDoS and memory leak attacks in distributed microservice topologies.

papers.title: Bangla Abstractive Text Summarization using Multi-Head Cross-Lingual Pretrained Encoders
papers.summary: Presented at Asian Conference on Natural Language Processing (ACNLP). Evaluates BanglaT5 and mBART fine-tuning on a novel benchmark dataset of 50,000 Bengali national news articles.

faqs.question: How do CSE students and faculty upload theses or conference papers?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Upload Thesis / Paper' button at the top of the Library or Home page. Select document type (Undergraduate Thesis, MSc Thesis, Conference Paper, Journal), enter student author names, supervisor name, abstract, keywords, and upload the scanned or digital PDF.

faqs.question: How does the search engine match papers?
faqs.answer: You can search by any keyword matching paper titles, student author names, faculty supervisor names, research tracks/topics, publication types, or abstract keywords instantly.

faqs.question: Are scanned thesis PDFs viewable directly in browser?
faqs.answer: Yes, every paper has an integrated instant PDF preview modal with self-healing PDF generation and one-click direct download.

projects.title: IoT Smart Agriculture & Automated Drip Irrigation System
projects.description: An automated solar-powered IoT hardware node deployed for precision agriculture in Pabna. Utilizes ESP32 microcontrollers and LoRa long-range wireless telemetry to measure soil moisture, ambient humidity, temperature, and NPK nutrient levels. Motorized drip irrigation solenoid valves trigger automatically based on moisture thresholds and cloud-synced weather forecast data.

projects.title: PUST Automated Exam Hall Seat Plan & Result Management Portal
projects.description: Comprehensive departmental web application for automating term-final examination seat allotment, preventing adjacent student roll collusion across departments, generating invigilator schedules, and calculating tabulated CGPA grade sheets with secure administrative digital approvals.

projects.title: Autonomous Hazardous Gas Detection & Surveillance Inspection Rover
projects.description: Hardware robotics prototype designed for industrial gas leak inspection, chemical storage monitoring, and hazardous zone reconnaissance. Features a 4WD tracked chassis with differential steering, multi-gas sensor matrix (Methane MQ-4, Carbon Monoxide MQ-7, LPG MQ-2, Hydrogen MQ-8), obstacle avoidance sonar, and real-time live video streaming over encrypted Wi-Fi link to a central ground station.

projects.title: Bengali Sign Language Interpreter with Embedded Vision & Audio Feedback
projects.description: An assistive technology solution combining camera vision and embedded edge compute. Captures 38 Bengali sign language gestures in real-time using landmark tracking and a lightweight quantized neural network on a Raspberry Pi 5, outputting both on-screen Bangla text and crystal-clear synthesized Bangla audio speech.

projects.title: PUST CSE Digital Research & Project Showcase Archive
projects.description: Unified web platform and digital archive for the Department of CSE, PUST. Offers structured cataloging for undergraduate theses, graduate dissertations, faculty research publications, software repositories, and hardware prototypes with multi-image demo upload galleries and instant search filtering.
